definitions.explanation: Formal conjunction used to connect nouns or noun phrases, equivalent to formal written 'and' in English.

examples.japanese: ⟦{氏名|しめい}→氏名：04033_shimei⟧{及|およ}び⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ご{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fill in your name and address.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧{及|およ}び⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{適用|てきよう}されます→適用する：21739_tekiyousuru⟧。
examples.english: This applies to the person and their family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧{及|およ}び⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: We plan to sell both domestically and overseas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧、⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧{及|およ}び⟦{福祉|ふくし}→福祉：13748_fukushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}する→活動：00201_katsudou⟧。
examples.english: We operate in the fields of education, healthcare, and welfare.

notes:
REGISTER: Formal/written. Used in:
- Legal documents
- Official forms
- Business correspondence
- Academic writing
- News reports

FORMALITY SCALE ("and"):
- ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: neutral, everyday
- ⟦や→や：10080_ya⟧: listing examples (implies more)
- {及|およ}び: formal, exhaustive
- ⟦{並|なら}びに→並びに：06923_narabini⟧: even more formal, often for separate categories

USAGE PATTERN: A{及|およ}びB connects two items at the same level. When listing three or more items:
- A、B{及|およ}びC (A, B, and C)

VS. ⟦{並|なら}びに→並びに：06923_narabini⟧:
- {及|およ}び: connects items at the same level
- ⟦{並|なら}びに→並びに：06923_narabini⟧: connects larger groups or categories
- Example: A{及|およ}びB⟦{並|なら}びに→並びに：06923_narabini⟧C{及|およ}びD = (A and B) and (C and D)

CAUTION: Using {及|およ}び in casual conversation sounds overly formal or stiff. Use ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ or ⟦や→や：10080_ya⟧ instead.
